As we wrap up, let’s pause and really take in what this journey has shown us.
Those small, everyday moments? They matter more than we realize. They shape how we see ourselves, and how we feel we belong.
Even silence—or the words we choose—can carry so much weight. They mold our relationships, our memories, and even the stories we pass down.
Our bodies, too, carry their own stories. Sometimes they feel vulnerable, but they can also be powerful sources of strength and joy.
And let’s not forget the power of art and storytelling. They help us bear witness, connect, and remind each other that we’re not alone in this.
The fight for recognition and justice? It’s ongoing. But it’s fueled by resilience and hope—qualities you carry with you.
If you’ve come this far, you’ve walked through a landscape of stories—some painful, some full of hope, all deeply human.
The path we’ve traced through *Citizen: An American Lyric* isn’t just about facing wounds and exclusion. It’s about how we keep healing, how we keep imagining new ways to live together.
There aren’t always easy answers. But there is comfort in knowing you’re not alone—in your questions, your struggles, or your longing for a better world.
So, as you move forward, remember: real change begins in those tiny, everyday moments. In the words you say. The stories you listen to. The ways you show up for people around you.
Let yourself be unsettled—but let yourself be moved, too.
The work of justice and belonging, it never really ends. But every act of witness, every small gesture of care, brings us all a little closer to the world we’re hoping to build.
You’re a part of that story now. So, keep going.
